title: Quarter consolidation: hosted API SLA alignment, model deprecation schedule, and eval guardrails
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: produce a consolidated, actionable quarter plan that aligns Hosted API SLAs, the public model catalog roadmap, and a staged model deprecation schedule while adding concrete evaluation guardrails and pricing considerations. Background: multiple PM threads (catalog curation, SLA tightening, migration paths for large models) have been running in parallel. Engineering needs a single source-of-truth plan to size Dedicated capacity, finalize kernel/quantization compatibility for prioritized models, and lock the customer communication timeline for model EOLs. This ticket will coordinate PM, Eng, Design, and Marketing deliverables into a single roadmap artifact and handoff to Delivery for execution.
acceptance_criteria: Single quarter roadmap artifact (sheet + canonical Confluence doc) that includes: release milestones, SLA targets by offering tier, and model deprecation dates
Signed off by Eng Lead (runtime), Security, and Customer Success
Clear migration guide for customers including recommended replacement models and compatibility notes
Evaluation guardrails: baseline prompt suites and regression thresholds defined for top 10 models
Pricing impact analysis with recommended per-model/route adjustments for hosted API
out_of_scope: Changes to Dedicated contractual terms (handled by Sales)
Large-scale infra procurement decisions beyond next quarter
notes: 2026-02-10: Kickoff meeting with Eng runtime, DS eval, CS and Legal. Collected initial asks: tighter SLOs for P99 latency on small routes; explicit deprecation lead time of 12 weeks for major model variants.
2026-02-18: Eng provided rough capacity estimate for preserving current SLAs under projected Q2 traffic. ACTION: PM to prioritize top 6 models for compatibility work to reduce risk.
2026-02-25: Pricing draft (Finance) attached to Confluence; shows potential 6-9% revenue uplift if switching lower-latency model variants to a premium route. Need exec review.
2026-03-04: Design reviewed customer comms playbook and requested a migration email cadence and console banner templates. Design to deliver templates by 2026-03-18.

2026-03-09: DS (Eval) defined initial prompt sets for safety and quality regression checks for top 10 models; threshold defaults proposed at 1.5% drop in accuracy or 2% drop in safety score to trigger rollback.
2026-03-12: PM sync — consolidated roadmap draft complete; collecting final signoffs. Next: schedule canary/deprecation test with Customer Success for three pilot customers (target start 2026-03-22).
